name: Inutomo - Aka Inu Kanchi no Meimou
original_name: イヌトモ 赤犬カンチの迷妄
source:
Kanchi drives to the mountains at night with friends. But they discover something unusual, and strange events start to pile up...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
晚上Kanchi和朋友开车去山里。但他们发现了一些不寻常的事情，奇怪的事件开始堆积起来……
